# Add a test for every behaviour change or bug fix

When a PR fixes a bug or adds or changes behaviour, include a test that exercises it. A good implementation without a test is not ready to merge.

**Why:** Requested on 10 PRs by 3 reviewers.

## Examples from PR review history

- > The implementation looks good, but can you add a test for this feature?
  — @sheremet-va on PR #9870: https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/pull/9870#pullrequestreview-4020097308
- > Could you check the failing tests and add new tests to `test/coverage-test` to validate this fix?
  — @AriPerkkio on PR #9426: https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/pull/9426#pullrequestreview-3646603622
- > Can you add test cases with reverse order?
  — @hi-ogawa on PR #9553: https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/pull/9553#discussion_r2744573247
